messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: High 5xx rate from EU loadbalancer (eu-west-1) affecting /v1/generate — spike >25% over 5m, increased latency. Trigger: metric-alert#445 (severity P1)
leo (sre-oncall): Got it, paging in. I'm on call. Investigating. @priya fyi
priya (eng-release): On it — just came off another deploy. Which rollout? Canary->global flip started ~20m ago for region-based blue/green.
sam (platform): Confirming: Traffic shift task "region-rollout-2026-03" pushed new env-id=green-eu-03. My logs show some clients still hitting old env (blue-eu-01) but returning 502s intermittently.
anna (eng-runtime): Seeing KV cache mismatch errors and 502 from green behind envoy probes. Also TTL for DNS weight update appears inconsistent across edge nodes: some edges still resolve to blue.
leo (sre-oncall): Customer-impact? maria?
maria (cust-succ): Initial alerts from 2 enterprise customers in EU. They see request timeouts and 502s. No major data loss, but UX failures. One has real-time generation use-case — it's degraded.
leo (sre-oncall): Ok, kill-switch checklist: 1) Pause rollout 2) Route EU traffic back to blue 3) Re-evaluate green. I'm going to pause rollout now.
priya (eng-release): Pausing via release API... done. release-service: pause returned 200. rollout_state=PAUSED.
devops-bot: Command executed: api call to release-manager pause  /releases/region-rollout-2026-03 -> 200 OK
sam (platform): DNS weighted update appears to be eventually consistent. We'll force anchor to blue by setting region weight 100->blue-eu-01. Running command:
```
infractl traffic set-weight --region eu-west --target blue-eu-01 --weight 100 --reason "rollback after failed canary"
```
devops-bot: infractl job queued job_id=job-7894
anna (eng-runtime): Quick note — we saw stale HTTP header X-Env:blue cached by edge for 2m causing sticky routing. Clearing edge caches now:
```
edgectl invalidate --region eu-west --path / -q
```
leo (sre-oncall): Running a smoke test curl against /health on both envs:
```
curl -s -D - https://api.eu.redwood.example/health | head -n 20
# green-eu-03 -> 502 Bad Gateway
# blue-eu-01  -> 200 OK
```
priya (eng-release): Confirmed. Green returning 502 for some routes, likely due to a model-serving process failing to bind to GPU after upgrade. Rolling back model docker image on green would be next, but prefer anchor traffic to blue first.
sam (platform): Weight job completed job-7894 -> success. Most edge nodes now resolve to blue, but ~10% of edges still returning old DNS due to TTL/forwarder cache. Working on short TTL flush via cdn API.
leo (sre-oncall): Notifying impacted customers (maria). Also opening a bug with eng-runtime for model start failure.
maria (cust-succ): Notified customers on the two incidents, gave ETA ~15m. They acknowledged; some switched to US region as workaround.
priya (eng-release): For postmortem, what killed green? I have logs from deploy:
```
[2026-03-15T14:02:31Z] model-runner failed to allocate GPU memory: cudaErrorUnknown
[2026-03-15T14:02:31Z] model-runner exited code 137
```
We pushed a runtime tweak for memory footprint. Might be incompat with new kernel or quant config.
anna (eng-runtime): We will attempt a quick fix: restart model-runner with env VAR FORCE_COLD_START=1 to rebuild cache. But since customers impacted, sticking with rollback to blue fully.
leo (sre-oncall): Current status: Rollback in progress, traffic anchored to blue ~90% across region, edge cache invalidation in progress. No data loss. Page will remain open until green is healthy and full weight restored or we revert permanently.
devops-bot: Incident timeline note created: incident-3067894321, severity=P1, link: https://redwood.incidents/3067894321
sam (platform): CDN TTL flush done for most edge nodes. Monitoring 5xx rate dropping.
leo (sre-oncall): 5xx rate down from 25% -> 3% in last 6m. Still seeing spikes up to 5% on a small subset. Keeping watch.
maria (cust-succ): Customers updated - they appreciate the quick rollback. One asked for postmortem and SLA credit if total downtime >5m.
priya (eng-release): I'll schedule a controlled canary re-deploy with additional observability flags and a smaller weight increment next time. Also add preflight GPU allocation smoke.
leo (sre-oncall): On-call handoff: @sam taking next 2 hours, I'll mark for followup. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup: 
sam (platform): Taking oncall. Will keep watch and drive postmortem notes.
incident-bot: Incident closed by sam (platform) at ts=3067894399 - resolution: rollback to blue + TTL flush. Severity downgraded to P2 for postmortem followup.
